# Congratulations

You're eligible to apply for the Vercel Startup Program.

## Tell us about you

Get Enterprise-tier access and up to **$30,000 in Flexible Commitment Amount*** to build and scale on Vercel.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Applications are evaluated using the following criteria:

- Startup must be affiliated with an approved Startups Partner (see full dropdown list above). This typically includes companies in accelerators, those backed by Venture Capital firms, or startups that meet certain criteria set by Vercel.
- Startup must not have previously received Vercel for Startups credits.
- Startup must have raised a Series A or less, and must apply within 12 months from their most recent funding round.
- Startup must have a company website, and an email address that matches the company website.
- Startup must have proof (screenshot of partner dashboard, hub, wiki, or console) demonstrating affiliation with an approved Vercel for Startups partner.

Your acceptance date determines which program rules apply. Startups accepted before August 6, 2026 remain on the legacy credit grant rules. Startups accepted on or after August 6, 2026 receive Flex Commit terms. Your original acceptance email outlines your grant amount and specific program benefits.

**Legacy credits (accepted before August 6, 2026):** Credits are a fixed discount on Vercel core infrastructure usage, including seats, data transfer, and compute, on Pro and Pro Trial plans. They do not cover v0 or AI Gateway usage. Your total grant is divided into equal monthly allowances over 12 months. For example, a $30,000 grant provides $2,500 per month for 12 months; your actual allowance depends on your grant. Unused credits do not roll over to the next month.

**Flex Commit (accepted on or after August 6, 2026):** Vercel offers Startups an enterprise grade contract with Flexible Commitment Amount up to $30,000 that can be used toward your Vercel usage, including seats, data transfer, compute, AI Gateway, v0 and more.

While this contract is active, your account runs on Vercel's **Enterprise Terms & Conditions**, giving you Enterprise-tier access for a year, or until you use up the allocated Flexible Commitment Amount. The Flexible Commitment Amount is issued to the team ID you applied within 5-7 business days from the point your team accepts these terms via email. The Flexible Commitment Amount can be used across Vercel products at your discretion. Unused Flexible Commitment Amounts on the one year anniversary of being granted do not roll over. If your team consumes the Flexible Commitment Amount before the one year anniversary, you will be invited to speak to a startups team advocate about extending your contract or switching to a Pro plan.

**Note:** You may only use up to 50% of your Flexible Commitment Amount towards Vercel AI Gateway usage. Flex Commit credit terms apply to startups accepted on or after August 6th, 2026. Founders accepted prior to August 6th should refer to the specific program benefits outlined in their original acceptance email.

Legacy credits for startups accepted before August 6, 2026 do not cover v0. For startups accepted on or after August 6, 2026, v0 is included as one of the applicable services under your Flexible Commitment. The Flexible Commitment Amount can be applied to v0 usage alongside Eve, Workflows, Sandboxes, AI Gateway, and the rest of the platform.

- Access to Vercel Team via Slack.
- Exclusive educational and networking opportunities with industry experts.
- Private Vercel for Startups events including demo days, hackathons, and other events aimed at helping you get product feedback, develop partnerships, and more.
- Opportunities for featured marketing by Vercel and Vercel’s leaders on social media.
- Exclusive Vercel for Startups swag.

Legacy startups accepted before August 6, 2026 receive benefits for up to one year from acceptance, subject to their original acceptance email. Flex Commit startups accepted on or after August 6, 2026 receive benefits for up to one calendar year from when their Flexible Commitment Amount is applied. This covers your Flexible Commitment Amount, Enterprise-tier access, and other program benefits. At the end of your one year period, or if you use up your full commitment amount sooner, your account automatically moves from Vercel's Enterprise Terms to our standard [Terms of Service](https://vercel.com/legal/terms), and you're billed monthly at Vercel’s standard list rates from that point forward for the services you are consuming. Please note that once your benefits have been activated, they cannot be postponed to a later date.

To apply for Vercel for Startups, visit [vercel.com/startups/credits](https://vercel.com/startups/credits) and fill out the application form. You'll need to provide your email, select or create a Vercel team, choose your startup partner, and upload proof of partnership. Our team will review your application and get back to you within 5-7 days. If approved, you'll be prompted to review and accept the Flexible Commitment for Startups Terms, at which point your credits and Enterprise access go live within 5-7 business days.

The contract is applied to a single team and not an individual's account. Once the contract has been signed, it cannot be transferred to a different team.

For legacy startups accepted before August 6, 2026, the grant is divided into equal monthly allowances over 12 months, with no rollover; refer to your original acceptance email for your grant amount. For Flex Commit startups accepted on or after August 6, 2026, the Flexible Commitment Amount depends on the arrangement between Vercel and your Startup Partner and may vary between partners, up to a maximum of $30,000. You will get access to the Flexible Commitment Amount once you accept the program terms, and it can be used across all Applicable Services during your one-year commitment period.

**Legacy credits (accepted before August 6, 2026):** Credits take effect on your next monthly invoice after approval and apply to monthly subscription invoices. They are not retroactive to paid invoices and do not apply to mid-cycle add-on purchases; those purchases are covered on the next monthly subscription invoice, subject to your monthly allowance.

**Flex Commit (accepted on or after August 6, 2026):** Once your application is approved and you accept the Flexible Commitment for Startups Terms, your contract takes effect immediately. Please note that a valid payment method must be on file for credits to be active and applied to your account. The contract cannot be used retroactively to previously paid invoices, and is not applied to mid-cycle invoices for add-on purchases.

**For Flex Commit startups, a maximum of 50% of each month's credit amount can be applied to Vercel AI Gateway usage.** If your AI Gateway Fees for the month exceed that 50% sub-limit, the excess is billed at standard rates rather than covered by credits—even if you have unused credit remaining elsewhere.

Issuance of credits is at Vercel's sole discretion, and Vercel reserves the right to revoke credits at any time for any reason, including abuse violations.

The Vercel for Startups program is an exclusive offer to companies backed by our Startup Partners. If you don’t see your partner listed here, please reach out to your VC to submit a partner request form on [vercel.com/startups/partners](https://vercel.com/startups/partners/#partner-form).

A payment method is required for all customers on this program, since fees beyond your Flexible Commitment Amount, or Fees incurred after your commitment period ends, are billed to that payment method. As a reminder, you can [limit how much you spend](https://vercel.com/docs/spend-management) on Vercel.

To view your current bill:

Legacy startups can view credit discounts on their monthly invoices. For Flex Commit startups, you should see an active Enterprise plan which has the proper dollar amount allocated to your startup’s team ID through the Flexible Commitment balance.

Legacy credits are limited to your monthly allowance. Usage beyond that allowance is not covered, and unused credits do not roll over. For Flex Commit startups accepted on or after August 6, 2026, if your Fees for Applicable Services exceed your Flexible Commitment Amount before your one-year period ends, your account automatically moves off Vercel's Enterprise Terms and onto our standard Terms of Service. From that point forward, you're billed monthly at standard list rates for the services listed at [vercel.com/docs/pricing/flex-commit](https://vercel.com/docs/pricing/flex-commit).

Legacy credits for startups accepted before August 6, 2026 do not cover AI Gateway usage. For Flex Commit startups accepted on or after August 6, 2026, this is a term of the program, not partner-specific. Up to 50% of your total allocated amount can go toward AI Gateway fees. If your Gateway usage for the month exceeds that 50% cap, the overage is billed normally, even if you still have unused credit available for other products.
